title: Robbery of Banco Totta e Açores, in Seia, on February 1, 1977
summary: Wikidata item Q115539271, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "robbery carried out by 3 elements of the PRP-BR, with 294,000$00 being stolen". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
